tei:div.tei:p: (45)mthon mthing ral pa'i rtsed paṇa rtser/ 'dabs rgyas padma'i ge sar la/ a gcig dri med 'od zer dang*/ dbyer med bstan pa'i nyi ma las skyong*/ bu snying nas chos bzhin byed 'dod na/ bca' kha shom ra sgrigs rgyu med/ kha pho kha bshad byed rgyu ci/ sems 'di'i 'gro ldog logs brtag nas/ mi dge rtog pa ci byung tshe/ yan par ma btang gnyen po brten/ so so'i skye bo'i sa 'di na/ nyon mongs mi skye med na yang*/ re re bzhin du 'bur 'joms dgos/ nyon mongs gang dang gang skyes kyang*/ cer gyis gnyen po stong pa nyid/ bsgom pa mchog ces gsung na'ang*/ 'dod chags ngos gnyen mi sdug dang*/ zhe snga byams pa gti mug la/ rten 'brel rnam dbye bsgom pa sogs/ mdor na rtog ngan gang skyes la/ de ma thag tu ngos bzung la/ thug phrad rbad chod gyis la thongs/ lung ma bstan pa'i spyod lam la/ bzo yi gnas sogs (46)gang la yang*/ ngos bzung dge ba'i lam la zhog dam chos bsgom sgrub thams cad la/ mi bslu yid ches sngon btang nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa brten/ mchog gsum nges shes thob pa dgos/ rang sems rang la mngon sum pas/ bla ma lha mchog gsum dang*/ mchod dang rang gi ma khrel na/ gzhan gyi smad kyang 'jigs med dgos/ 'di snang zhen pa'i rtog ngan la/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi pa yis/ blo sna'i 'gro ldog skad cig la/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pa/ 'di gsum gyis ni skya bar nas/ 'donapa dam pa'i phyag bzhes lags/ sngon 'gro blo ldog tshul rnams la/ gal chung don med mi sems par/ rang gi sems 'di dge bar sbyang*/ rang sems nyo mongs skyon brtags nas/ rang skyon rang gi shes byas la/ rang sems rang gi ma thul na/ gzhan gyi btul kyang rtsod pa'i gzhi/ 'khor ba 'di na gang ci rung*/ tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal las/ bde ba'i go (47)skabs rnyed min pa/ bsam nas skyo shas nges 'byung gis/ sems 'di yang nas yang du sbyong*/

thams cad mkhyen pas gzigs pa'i yul/ las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i gnas/ dge sdig las kyi blang dor la/ zhib cha rgyud la gang thon gyis/ sdig pa phra mo tsam gcig gis/ bskal bar ngan 'gro 'gro 'gyur na/ thog med 'khor bar bsags sdig gis/ bde 'gro mi 'gra smos mi dgos/ stong nyid mthon po'i chos skad la/ nyan nas rang rgyud chud ma gzon/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi dang rten/ lam dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi mjod/ lam rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ mnyes pa gsum gyi thugs zin dgos/ phyi pa nang ba'i khyad par la/ brten bya skyabs kyi khyad par gyi/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum/ ston pa lam dang lam gyi grogs/ yid ches snying nas skyabs 'gro dgos/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dgon pa/ 'jigs dang (48)sdug bsngal gnas rnams la/ skyob pa 'di las gzhan med pas/ blo rtse skyabs 'gro gcig pu'i mjod/ 'jig rten pha dang ma dang ni/ gnyen bshes grogs dang dga' ma rnams/ 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching thang la/ blo gtad ci cha rang thag chod/ rang mgo nyi ma chos kyi thon/ sems la yar skyed ma thon na/ theg pa'i yar skyed dgos pa chung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen su to bas/ chos rnams kun gyi dang po la/ 'chi ba bsgom dang byang chub sems/ gnyis po 'di la 'du sde nas gsungs/ ma rnams sems can kun don du/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu/ sems kyi khyad par rmad byung ba/ rin chen byang chub sems 'di la/ rnam pa kun tu blo sbyong gyis/ 'di med lam gyis gzugs brnyan 'ga'/ phyi tshul bzang dang sgrub tshugs brtan/ bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len rnams/ snying med ro bzhin ma gzigs sam/ kye ma dengs sang snyigs ma'i dus/ 'dul ba snal ma'i mdog la (49)re/ byang sems phyi tshul 'chos la 'jin/ bskyed rjogs kha pho mtho la re/ de 'dra'i lad ma mo'i ma byed cig mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma ni/ mi 'bral spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsam/

skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du/ nges par mos gus drag po yis/ thugs dam gdung ba'i glus bskul na/ byin rlabs rje sprin bzhin 'du/ nyams dang rtogs pa sa lam gyi/ yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas/ mos gus dkar po gcig thub 'di/ rjogs chen lta sgom spyod pa'i gnas/ lam rnams kun gyi bsgom 'dun du/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis bsngags/ skye med chos sku'i rgyal khab na/ srid zhi kun gyi snying po'i bcud/ mtshon bya don gyi bla ma dang*/ 'du 'bral med snying gi bu/ nga ni ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pas/ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas thob/ 'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid lha/ kun (50)bzang chos sku'i bla ma la/ nye ring 'jin pa byis pa'i blo/ dngos 'jin ma byed gsol ba thob/ gang zhing mos pas sgrub byed na/ nga nyid rtag tu mi 'byon re/ las can bu la byin gyis brlabs/ mchog thun dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs/ de ltar mos pa'i srog bzung nas/ bla ma rtag tu sgrub byed na/ 'gal rkyen ngan pa lam slong nas/ yang dag lam du 'gro bar nges/ sngon 'gro'i chos gzhung ma shor ste/ thun mong min pa'i nyams len la/ rtag tu rnam g.yeng spang la bsgoms/ sems nyid rig stong rjen pa'i gshis/ phra rags rtog pa ma sbags par/ rab bab ma bcos rjen seng nge*/ tha mal shes pa rang yan ltos/ dgongs pa chu bo'i klung chen gyi/ cog bzhag rnam pa bzhi yi sgrom/ mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgom pa yis/ gnyug ma rang bab bsam gtan la/ rtag tu nyams len brtson par mjod/ stong bas ci phan sems kyis bzos/ snang bas mi gnod chos sku'i rtsal/ (51)thams cad ro mnyam chen po la/ spang blang re dogs bral bar skyong*/ 'gro 'am gnas sam 'gyus kyang rung*/ grol tshul chu la ri mo bzhin/ rang shar rang grol rtog mtha' zad/ 'gyu ba stong pas gtan med skyongs/

sngon 'gro nas bzung dngos gzhi'i bar/ sngar nas rgyas par zhus zin pas/ brjod nges ma skyur dran shes gyis/ bzung nas thugs la nges par sbyong*/ rnam g.yeng ma mjad sgrub la gzhol/ nam zhig dus kyi nyen pa'i tshe/ chos dang bla ma ma gtogs par/ skyabs dang skyob pa ma mchis pas/ da ris mthun rkyen tshang ba'i dus/ 'bongs gsum dam pa'i chos la mjod/ rigs dang 'byor pa'i grags pa la/ snyem pa ma 'chang dman nus zung*/ na gzhon byis pa'i kun spyod la/ mig ltos ma byed btsun tshugs zungs/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la/ stong ltos ma bslad zhib tshags gyis/ byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ gal chung ma sems (52)rgyud la skyongs*/ 'di snang sgyu ma'i bslu brid la/ chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin dor/ lta bsgom spyod pa'i nyams len gnad/ nyon mongs gnyen pos non pa dgos/ de ltar ma yin mdo sngags la/ kha bshad ne tsho'i 'don par 'gro rang sems rang la dpang btsug nas/ rtag tu rang rgyud gtsang bar mjod/ kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i logs bshad las/ sngon nas chos la legs goms pas/ da lta 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi/ rje btsun chos dbyings dbang mos bskul/ rnam g.yeng mi tshe gyi nas 'da'/ gzhan don ltar snang bshes gnyen gzugs/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyis phul/ dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ byang chub lam gyi bar chad sel/ mthun rkyen ma tshang med pa las/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad kyi/ bstan pa phyogs brgyar rgyas par smon/ sarba dā ka lyaṃ/
